card: Updates DescriptorScriptPubKeyMan::FillPSBT to use PSBTInput::GetUTXO for selecting signing keys instead of reading witness_utxo directly. Previously, an input with conflicting witness and non-witness UTXO fields caused FillPSBT to look up keys for the witness script while SignPSBTInput required keys for the non-witness script, leaving owned inputs unsigned. The change also ensures FillPSBT immediately returns MISSING_INPUTS when non_witness_utxo is malformed or txid-mismatched. No fund safety issues were involved as this bug only led to incomplete PSBTs rather than bad signatures.
changed_since_previous: The core fix remains the same, organized into two commits that document and unit-test PSBTInput::GetUTXO resolution behavior before updating FillPSBT.
evidence: PR description: 'When the two disagreed, FillPSBT loaded keys for the witness_utxo script while SignPSBTInput signed the non_witness_utxo spend. This could lead to an incomplete input even though the wallet owns the appropriate non_witness_utxo script.'
Regression test fillpsbt_signs_despite_conflicting_witness_utxo confirms that signing an owned input succeeded only after routing script selection through GetUTXO.
problem: When a PSBT input includes both witness_utxo and non_witness_utxo with conflicting scriptPubKeys, FillPSBT selected signing keys matching witness_utxo while SignPSBTInput attempted to sign for non_witness_utxo. As a result, the wallet would fail to produce a complete signature even if it owned the keys for the non_witness_utxo spend.

risk.why: Flaws in UTXO extraction or key provider selection could cause the wallet to fail to sign legitimate PSBT inputs or mishandle malformed transactions.

summary: Updates DescriptorScriptPubKeyMan::FillPSBT to select signing providers via PSBTInput::GetUTXO instead of inspecting witness_utxo directly. This aligns FillPSBT with SignPSBTInput by prioritizing a verified non_witness_utxo over witness_utxo and immediately rejecting mismatched or malformed non-witness UTXOs.
